BJP MLA Injured During Temple Ritual When Scale Breaks

BJP MLA V Muraleedharan sustained a leg injury when a weighing scale broke during a temple ritual in Thiruvananthapuram. The incident occurred while he was participating in a traditional ceremony. He was reportedly injured by the snapping scale.
